data.one_liner: Create customizable horizontal or vertical sliding switch widgets in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SlideSwitcher widget that allows users to toggle between multiple child widgets using a sliding selection mechanism. It supports custom colors, gradients, borders, shadows, and both horizontal and vertical orientations.
use_when: You need a segmented control or sliding toggle switch in your UI
You want to switch views or states based on user tab selection with customized styling
avoid_when: You need complex form builders or dropdown selectors
Your children widgets do not fit within the defined container size constraints
strengths: Extensive customization options including colors, gradients, and borders
Supports both horizontal and vertical directions
Includes initial index and tap-to-switch functionality for 2 children
weaknesses: Strict size constraints can throw exceptions if children do not fit the container size
Some features like 'isAllContainerTap' are restricted to exactly 2 children
data.minimal_example:
SlideSwitcher(
  children: [
    Text('First'),
    Text('Second'),
  ],
  onSelect: (index) {},
  containerHeight: 40,
  containerWight: 350,
)
